pytorch.cuda_initialization_error: Error 304: OS call failed or operation not supported on this OS

cuda_tensor_sanity_check.error: RuntimeError during torch CUDA initialization: cudaGetDeviceCount error 304

stop_reason: NVIDIA GPU device nodes are not exposed to the Studio process; nvidia-smi cannot communicate with the driver and torch.cuda.is_available() is false.
required_remediation: Restart or reconfigure the Lightning Studio so the attached L4 is exposed through /dev/nvidia* and nvidia-smi succeeds, then rerun GPU verification before installation or training.
